services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Every vessel is U.S. Coast Guard inspected and run by crews who know these waters. From quick half-day runs to overnight long-range trips, there’s a boat for the day you have in

services.name: Whale Watch & Tours
services.desc: Out to see the wildlife instead? Our tour boats run whale-watch trips and ocean cruises - gray and blue whales in season, plus dolphins and sea lions year-round along the South Bay

includes: Rod rentals, tackle, and one-day licenses available at the landing
blurb: Guests fish aboard a U.S. Coast Guard–inspected fleet with experienced crews. Trips include half-day, full-day, overnight, multi-day, and private charters. Rod rentals, tackle, and licenses are available at the landing.
extraNote: At the landing on Redondo Beach Pier
